name: C-boundary-head
_doc: Research-loop spec for NS-P1 method bet C. Run from repo ROOT: python experiments/research_loop/loop.py --spec research/TimeLens/c_head/loop_c.json . FROZEN FRAME: action space = {arm, lr, lambda_giou, epochs, tag}; gate = beat text-decode baseline on [0,2s) R@0.7 (s0_r07) while keeping mid/long mIoU >= 0.55 (no M/L regression). Validated by the post-answer smoke before use.
run_cmd: env -u VIRTUAL_ENV CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES={gpu} OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/python -m c_head.train_head --tag {tag} --arm {arm} --name {name} --lr {lr} --lambda_giou {lambda_giou} --epochs {epochs}
score_cmd: env -u VIRTUAL_ENV PYTHONPATH=. uv run python research/TimeLens/score_head.py --ckpt {name} --json {json_out}
